mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, ud.is_primary, ud.status FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON ud.dept_id = d.id AND d.status = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ud.is_primary DESC, ud.create_time DESC

SELECT up.id, up.post_id, sp.post_name, sp.post_code, up.is_primary, up.status FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON up.post_id = sp.id AND sp.status = 1 AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY up.is_primary DESC, up.create_time DESC

SELECT id, username, nickname FROM sys_user WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 AND ( username LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR employee_no LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
